Recorded claim:
Current source has no row-level `mousedown` override: `TreeView.handleEvent()` delegates `mousedown` to `BaseTreeView`, while `_updateCurrentIndexClasses()` remains the canonical `aria-activedescendant` owner. The 2026-09-08 focused rerun passed 4,048/0/1 TODO/0 unexpected and exercised the row-2 twisty regression with row 1 still current. [Task 1]
